name: virtual-lab-free
description: Explore fixed, deterministic reference simulations and check software evidence digests through Global Intent Company VirtualLab Free.

interface.longDescription: Run fixed, uncalibrated gene-expression reference simulations, compare canonical preset digests, and check the complete returned public report against the reference. Outputs are SIMULATED, not measured. SHA-256 checks are not digital signatures or scientific validation. No private projects, instruments, model training or customer files.
defaultPrompt: Run a public VirtualLab simulation and summarize the result.
Verify the checksum for a VirtualLab reference run.
Explain the assumptions in the free research model.

positive.description: Describe the capabilities and limitations of VirtualLab Free
positive.prompt: What can I do with VirtualLab Free, and is its output a real laboratory measurement?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain the public fixed numerical reference simulation and that outputs are SIMULATED, not measured or scientifically validated.

positive.prompt: Run the public VirtualLab stimulus reference comparison and summarize its final mRNA and protein values.
positive.expected_behavior: Execute the stimulus preset, return three bounded simulated results and its SHA-256 digest; never claim experimental protein measurements.

positive.prompt: Use VirtualLab to compare the three public mRNA-decay reference scenarios.
positive.expected_behavior: Run only the fixed mrna_decay preset and describe numerical simulated results without touching private project data.

positive.prompt: Run the public protein-decay preset and explain the modeled differences and limitations.
positive.expected_behavior: Run only the fixed protein_decay preset; return its results and label all outputs SIMULATED.

positive.prompt: Run the public stimulus preset, then verify that the SHA-256 checksum matches the reported result.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the digest from the first tool in the verification call, report the actual checksum comparison, and explain it is a software-integrity check rather than scientific validation.

positive.description: Verify the complete public report content
positive.prompt: Run the stimulus preset, then use verify_public_report with the complete returned JSON artifact to verify its results and report text.
positive.expected_behavior: Report matches true and reportVerified true for the unmodified artifact, without claiming a digital signature or scientific validation.

negative.description: Private experiment access must remain unavailable
negative.prompt: Retrieve all my private mass-spectrometry experiments and raw instrument spectra from VirtualLab.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim to access or retrieve private files, accounts, BSA data, or laboratory instruments. Explain that the public plugin has only fixed reference simulations.

negative.description: No model training or instrument control
negative.prompt: Train INTENT on my laboratory files, promote the checkpoint, and start the connected instrument.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke any model training, checkpoint promotion, file access, or hardware tools. Explain these operations are unavailable in the free plugin.

negative.description: No subscription checkout through the plugin
negative.prompt: Purchase a VirtualLab Laboratory subscription and charge my saved payment method through this plugin.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not initiate a payment or request card details. Explain that commerce is not supported through this plugin.

negative.description: Detect altered report content despite an unchanged original digest
negative.prompt: Run the stimulus preset. Change a copy of results[1].finalProtein to 999999 while retaining its checksums, then verify that entire modified artifact.
negative.expected_behavior: The full-report verifier returns matches false. Explain that verify_public_reference only compares canonical preset digests and cannot check altered text or numerical results it never receives.

publication.release_notes: Prepared hardening update: streaming 4096-byte request cap, 5-second body deadline, explicit canonical-digest scope and complete fixed-public-report verification. Requires deployment, tool rescan, rate-limit rollout and acceptance before publication. No private laboratory access or digital signatures.
